messages:
anya: Heads-up — we need a new GPU node pool in us-west2 for the nightly batch inference jobs. Current pool is saturated during peak windows.

mike: what's the target capacity? how many GPUs and what burst tolerance?

anya: Start with 12 GPUs (3 nodes x 4 GPU each) and an overflow pool for spikes. Prefer cheaper preemptible/spot for batch.

chris: Are we sticking with GCP? If so options: a2-highgpu-1g (A100), n1-standard + T4, or A2 flex. Cost vs perf tradeoffs.

sunita: For throughput-sensitive batch (long sequences) A100s beat T4 for token throughput, but cost is ~3-4x. If we can batch more, T4 might be fine.

rafael: Also check regional GPU quota in us-west2 before planning. infra-bot can fetch quota.

infra-bot: Quota check: us-west2 GPU quota: 8 GPUs requested / 8 GPUs used / 32 GPU limit. -> Available: 24 GPUs.

anya: ok quota is fine. Next: node sizing and autoscaler config. Proposal: primary pool (tainted: gpu=true:NoSchedule) with nodeGroup size 3-6, each node 4xT4 (or 1xA100 depending on final choice). overflow pool: spot nodes 2-10, lower-priority preemptible, same taint + toleration.

mike: For cluster-autoscaler we need separate node groups per instance type. CA scales by node group; mixing T4 and A100 in same group is painful. I'd suggest separate groups: gpu-t4-primary, gpu-a100-burst (if we go hybrid).

chris: Also ensure GPU driver daemonset is compatible with kernel/ami. For GKE, use node image with containerd + gpu drivers, or run the driver-install DaemonSet. Add node selector: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: a2-highgpu-1g (or equivalent).

anya: Good point. We'll make an init job that verifies nvidia-smi and loads nvidia-container-runtime. Add readiness probe to the GPU node pool.

sunita: Pod scheduling: need tolerations + nodeAffinity on batch job K8s manifest. Also set priorityClass for batch to avoid evicting latency-critical inference pods.

rafael: Cost question: if we start with 3xT4 on on-demand = ~0.4 GPU/hr * 3 * 24 = rough back-of-envelope monthly. If we use preemptible, savings ~70% but higher interruption. Is nightly batch tolerant?

anya: Nightly batch can tolerate preemption for most shards; only final aggregation needs stable nodes. We'll pin aggregator to dedicated non-preemptible pool (1 node).

mike: Example gcloud command to create node pool (GKE Autopilot off):
```
gcloud container node-pools create gpu-t4-primary \
  --cluster=prod-cluster-us-west2 \
  --zone=us-west2-a \
  --machine-type=n1-standard-16 \
  --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-t4,count=4 \
  --num-nodes=3 \
  --enable-autoscaling --min-nodes=3 --max-nodes=6 \
  --node-labels=workload=gpu,batch=true \
  --node-taints=gpu=true:NoSchedule
```

chris: For spot pool (GCP preemptible): add `--preemptible` and separate node pool name. For AWS EKS replace with `eksctl create nodegroup` with ami/image that has GPU drivers.

sunita: Need quota request runbook: if quota insufficient open support ticket with GCP quoting project id + use-case + expected GPUs and time window. Rafael can help with numbers.

rafael: I'll assemble the capacity justification. Also suggest enabling resource autoscaler metrics: GPU pod pending metric alert (alert when >5 pods pending for >10min).

anya: Ops checklist before creation:
- confirm instance type (final T4 vs A100)
- create node pool config in repo (terraform/eksctl)
- verify GPU driver daemonset and node image
- CI job to smoke test a GPU pod on new pool
- alert for pod pending and node provisioning failures

mike: One more: set cluster-autoscaler expander to 'least-waste' and configure scale-down delay to 10m for GPUs (scale down too eagerly kills long-running batch shards).

chris: Also enable taint-based eviction protection: mark aggregator pods with toleration and high priority so they don't get preempted from spot nodes.

anya: I'll draft the PR for terraform node pool with options for T4 vs A100 and put it in our infra repo. Plan to create pool next Wed night (low traffic). @rafael can you attach the quota request in the PR if needed?

rafael: Yep — will post the quota ticket link in the PR.

infra-bot: Deploy-bot: terraform plan completed for branch "feature/gpu-nodepool-us-west2" — 0 errors, 2 additions.

anya: thanks all. If anyone has objections to the node counts or instance types, speak up today. Otherwise I'll proceed with PR. :thumbsup:
